name: Dog-Eared Books
description: Independent bookshop & café template with staff-pick book covers that swing open in 3D to reveal handwritten-style bookseller notes.
features: Six illustrated CSS/SVG book covers that open on hover or keyboard focus
Pausable marquee of staff-pick one-liners with a dedicated pause button
Chalkboard café menu and due-date-stamp events list
Library-card styled contact form with topic selector
signature: Book covers open like a real book in 3D on hover/focus; staff-pick one-liners drift past in a slow marquee that pauses on hover
